Owvie is built so you can hand your child a story and step away, knowing exactly what they'll hear and what they won't.

Screen-free by design

Owvie is audio-first. Press play and the screen can go dark. No flashing video, no autoplay rabbit-holes, and less blue light before sleep.

No ads. No data selling.

Your child is never shown a single ad, and we never sell your family's data to anyone. Our only business is the subscription you choose.

Every story is written to fit your child's age and to leave them with something good. Curious, kind, and calm. Nothing scary, nothing cynical, nothing that doesn't belong at bedtime.

Billing questions

The fine print, in plain words

When am I charged?
Never during your 24-hour preview or your 7-day free trial. Your first payment is only taken when the trial ends, and we remind you before that happens.
How do I cancel?
Anytime, from your phone's subscription settings (App Store or Google Play). Cancel before the trial ends and you won't be charged a thing.
Can I restore a purchase on a new phone?
Yes. Sign in with the same Apple or Google account, open Settings → Manage Subscription in the app, and tap Restore Purchases.
Do you offer refunds?
Refunds are handled by Apple and Google under their store policies. Email us at hello@owvie.com and we'll do our best to help.
Support

We're here to help.

Answers to the questions parents ask most, plus a real inbox when you need one.

How do I start the free trial?
Download Owvie, create your child's profile, and you'll get a 24-hour preview right away. When you're ready for everything, tap to begin the 7-day free trial. No card is needed for the preview.
How do I cancel my subscription?
Open Settings → Manage Subscription in the app, or go to your subscriptions in the App Store / Google Play. Cancel before your trial ends to avoid any charge.
How do I restore my purchases?
Sign in with the same store account you subscribed with, then open Settings → Manage Subscription → Restore Purchases.
How many children can I add?
Up to six kid profiles per account, each with its own age, goals, and favourites.
Can my child listen offline?
Yes. Download any story ahead of time and it plays with no internet, perfect for cars, planes, and patchy Wi-Fi.
Which devices does Owvie work on?
iPhone and iPad, plus Android phones and tablets. Stories play in the background and on the lock screen, just like a podcast.
How do I delete my account and data?
Open Settings → Account → Delete Account. We remove your data on a compliant timeline, in line with COPPA and DPDP. Need a hand? Email hello@owvie.com.
Is the content right for my child's age?
Every story is tuned to an age band, from the littlest listeners up to age 12, and sorted into three worlds (Brainiacs, Feelings, and Super Powers), so what your child hears fits where they are.

Still need a hand?

Our story

Why we made Owvie.

Bedtime should be the calm part of the day, not a nightly standoff with a bright screen.

Why Owvie

Every parent knows the bedtime contradiction: the thing that finally settles a child is a story, but the device that tells it keeps them wired. Bright video, autoplay, ads, and a feed with no bottom are the opposite of sleep. We wanted the opposite of all of it.

What Owvie does

Owvie is audio-first. A warm voice, a story written to wind down toward calm, and a screen that can go completely dark. No ads, no autoplay traps, nothing pulling for one more minute of attention.

Hundreds of original stories live in three worlds, Brainiacs for curiosity, Feelings for the big emotions, and Super Powers for confidence and character, alongside Infinite Music for nights that just need a gentle loop. Everything is tuned to your child's age, from the littlest listeners up to age 12.

How it started

Owvie began with one stubborn bedtime problem and a refusal to solve it with another glowing screen. It grew from a simple belief: that the last thing a child hears at night should be calm, kind, and worth remembering.

Today Owvie helps families across India and the United States wind down at night, and every story we add is held to the same test, does it help a child slow down, feel something good, and drift off?

Legal

Privacy Policy

How Owvie handles your family's information. Last updated August 2026.

Owvie is a bedtime audio app made for children and the parents who care for them. Protecting your family's privacy is central to how we build it. This policy explains what we collect, why, and the choices you have.

Information we collect

We keep this to a minimum: the email address used to create your account, basic device and app information needed to run and secure the service, and how the app is used (for example, which stories are played) so we can improve it. We do not ask for your child's real name, and we do not collect precise location.

Children's privacy

Owvie is designed to meet children's privacy standards, including the US Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA) and India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDP). Accounts are created and managed by a parent or guardian. We do not show behavioral advertising to children, and we never sell your family's data.

How we use information

To provide the app, personalize story recommendations by age, process your subscription, keep the service secure, respond to support requests, and understand in aggregate how Owvie is used so we can make it better.

How information is shared

We share information only with the service providers that help us run Owvie, such as hosting, payments, and analytics, under contracts that limit their use of it. We do not sell your data. Where we measure advertising, we do so in a privacy-protective, aggregated way, and we never send information about your child.

Keeping and deleting data

You can delete your account and associated data at any time from within the app (Settings, then Account, then Delete Account) or by contacting us. When you delete your account, we remove your data on a defined, compliant schedule.

Security

We use industry-standard measures to protect your information, including encryption in transit and at rest. No system is perfectly secure, but we work hard to keep yours safe.

Your rights

You can access, correct, or delete your information, and withdraw consent, using the app's settings or by emailing us. We honor the rights available to you under applicable law.

Contact us

Questions about this policy? Email hello@owvie.com and a real person will help.

Terms of Service

The agreement between you and Owvie. Last updated August 2026.

By downloading or using Owvie, you agree to these terms. Owvie is operated by Owvie Innovations Pvt. Ltd. Please read them carefully.

Who can use Owvie

Owvie is intended for children, with accounts created and managed by a parent or legal guardian who is an adult. By creating an account, you confirm you are an adult and responsible for how the app is used in your household.

Subscriptions and billing

Owvie offers a free preview and a free trial, followed by monthly or yearly subscriptions. Prices are shown in the app and on this site, in US dollars for the United States and Indian rupees for India. Subscriptions are purchased and managed through the Apple App Store or Google Play, renew automatically unless cancelled, and can be cancelled at any time in your device's subscription settings. Refunds are handled under the store's policies.

Acceptable use

Please use Owvie for personal, non-commercial family use. Do not copy, resell, or redistribute our stories, music, or other content, and do not attempt to disrupt or misuse the service.

Content and ownership

All stories, music, artwork, and other content in Owvie are owned by Owvie or its licensors and are provided to you for personal use within the app. Your subscription grants a limited, revocable licence to enjoy that content, not to own it.

Disclaimers

Owvie is provided "as is." We work hard to keep it safe, reliable, and calming, but we cannot promise it will always be uninterrupted or error-free. To the extent permitted by law, our liability is limited.

Ending your use

You can stop using Owvie and delete your account at any time. We may suspend or end access if these terms are broken. Some provisions, such as ownership and disclaimers, continue after your account ends.
